name: Logitech MX Master 3S Wireless Mouse
caption:
This scroll wheel can fly through a thousand lines in one second. 🖱️

The Logitech MX Master 3S has Quiet Clicks, an 8,000 DPI sensor that tracks even on glass, and up to 70 days of battery from one USB-C charge.

It connects by Bluetooth or the Logi Bolt receiver.

Tip: pair it with more than one computer and switch between them with a button.
